rule_counter_repeat.note: Same counter at the cap for asks up to 1.50 x cap, at most 3 rule counters per conversation (the 1.18 first counter included), then walk away without a model. over_budget_counter stays as it is.

first_message_conditions.note: Food orders only: by order hash, the share in the conditions arm state the order's accepted grades, needed hours of shelf life and certificate in the first message; the control arm sends today's message unchanged. Goods wording is unchanged. Missing, broken or not true means off.

food_lower_grade_sentence.note: Approved 11-09: food orders that send the conditions message; by order hash (its own salt) the share in the test arm add one sentence naming exactly the lower grades the order accepts ('Grade B is fine' or 'Grade B or C is fine if it meets these conditions; price matters more to us than grade.'), so it never invites a quote we would refuse. Control, goods and every check after the first message are unchanged. Missing, broken or not true means off.

goods_first_message_grades.note: Goods orders only: by order hash (its own salt), the share in the conditions arm add one sentence stating the order's accepted grades after 'I want to buy {item}.'; the certificate and warranty sentences and the control arm are unchanged. Missing, broken or not true means off.

standing_ask_at_floor.note: Buyer option 1, approved 11-09: by order hash (its own salt), the share in the test arm take the seller's clear current ask once, at the point the run would walk away from it, when the ask is within the grade-adjusted floor ceiling and the order budget and the quote passed; counters, the floor, the receipt checks and the control arm are unchanged. Missing, broken or not true means off.

retry_other_shop.note: One retry at another shop for an order the first shop lost, inside our run, to a quote with short shelf life or an unacceptable grade, or to a refusal at the first message. Refusals by the kit at payment come after our run returns and are never retried. Missing, broken or not true means off. errors_before_offer (approved 11-09): also retry an agent or transport error when no offer or accept left the run; by error type and trail state only. Missing or not true means off.
